content.short: UniSat is the leading non-custodial wallet for Bitcoin-native assets including Ordinals, BRC-20, and Runes tokens.
content.description: UniSat is the definitive self-custodial wallet and inscription service built specifically for the emerging Bitcoin-native ecosystem. As the first open-source wallet to support Ordinals and BRC-20 tokens, the platform provides users with a secure gateway to create, store, and trade digital assets directly on the Bitcoin blockchain. UniSat features a highly accessible interface that supports advanced standards such as Runes, serving as a primary hub for Bitcoin-native innovation. In addition to its wallet features, UniSat provides a robust marketplace and an inscription tool.
